formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj], (∀ (v : Fin n) (p : G.Walk v v), p.IsCycle → 5 ≤ p.length) → ∀ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n D = (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide (∃ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j ∧ x i = true ∧ x j = true)) → ∃ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j → i ∈ T ∨ j ∈ T) ∧ G.edgeFinset.card + T.card ≤ D.size + 1
plain_statement: For every graph G with no cycle of length below 5 (any degrees) and every circuit of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, every gate counted, that is true exactly when both ends of some edge of G are true, there is a vertex cover T of G with (number of edges) + |T| at most (number of gates) + 1. So such a circuit has at least edges plus the cover number minus one gates; the circuit built from a least cover meets this with equality. Conjecture, supported by small graphs only.
title: Conjecture: circuits of AND and OR gates for the edge function of a graph with no cycle shorter than 5 have at least edges + cover - 1 gates
